---
title: "Models"
---

Earth2Studio.jl wraps two categories of AI weather models: **prognostic** models that step the atmosphere forward in time, and **diagnostic** models that derive additional quantities from the forecast state.

## Prognostic Models

Prognostic models produce multi-step weather forecasts. Each constructor downloads pretrained weights on first use.

| Constructor | Description | Step Size |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `FourCastNet()` | NVIDIA FourCastNet v1/v2 | 6h |
| `FCN3()` | FourCastNet v3 | 6h |
| `Pangu24()` | Pangu-Weather | 24h |
| `Pangu6()` | Pangu-Weather | 6h |
| `Pangu3()` | Pangu-Weather | 3h |
| `GraphCast()` | DeepMind GraphCast (small) | 6h |
| `GraphCastOper()` | GraphCast operational | 6h |
| `AIFS()` | ECMWF AIFS | 6h |
| `AIFSENS()` | ECMWF AIFS ensemble | 6h |
| `Aurora()` | Microsoft Aurora | 6h |
| `FengWu()` | Shanghai AI Lab FengWu | 6h |
| `DLWP()` | Deep Learning Weather Prediction | 6h |
| `StormCast()` | NVIDIA StormCast (convective) | varies |
| `InterpModAFNO()` | Interpolation model (AFNO) | varies |
| `Persistence()` | No-skill baseline | any |

### Loading a Model

```julia
model = Pangu24()
```

Models are loaded on CPU by default. Move to GPU with:

```julia
to_device!(model, "cuda")
```

### Custom Package Path

Override the default weight package:

```julia
model = Pangu24(package="/path/to/custom/weights")
```

Or construct from any class name:

```julia
model = PrognosticModel("FCN")
```

## Diagnostic Models

Diagnostic models transform forecast fields into derived quantities. AI-based diagnostics load pretrained weights; derived quantities are analytic.

### AI-Based Diagnostics

| Constructor | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `CorrDiff()` | Generative downscaling |
| `CorrDiffTaiwan()` | CorrDiff (Taiwan domain) |
| `CorrDiffCMIP6()` | CorrDiff (CMIP6 data) |
| `PrecipitationAFNO()` | Precipitation estimation |
| `PrecipitationAFNOv2()` | Precipitation estimation v2 |
| `ClimateNet()` | Extreme weather detection |
| `SolarRadiationAFNO1H()` | Solar radiation (1h) |
| `SolarRadiationAFNO6H()` | Solar radiation (6h) |
| `TCTrackerVitart()` | TC tracker (Vitart) |
| `TCTrackerWuDuan()` | TC tracker (Wu-Duan) |

### Derived Quantities (No Weights)

| Constructor | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `DerivedRH()` | Relative humidity |
| `DerivedVPD()` | Vapor pressure deficit |
| `DerivedWS()` | Wind speed |

### Custom Diagnostic

```julia
model = DiagnosticModel("CorrDiff")
```
